title: Lightly Glazed French Ume Plum Skewers
description: A pungent and molten French dish featuring ume-plum, render-fat, and Mediterranean-friendly flavors, grilled to perfection on a robata grill.
instructions: Preheat the robata grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small bowl, whisk together the rendered duck fat, honey, balsamic vinegar, thyme, garlic, salt, and black pepper.
Thread the ume-plums onto skewers, leaving a small space between each plum.
Brush the glaze mixture onto both sides of the ume-plums.
Grill the skewers for 2-3 minutes per side, or until the plums are tender and slightly charred.
Serve the skewers immediately, garnished with additional thyme if desired.
Let the skewers rest for 1-2 minutes before serving to allow the juices to redistribute.
Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F before serving.
